name: recover-mass-action
title: Recover mass-action kinetics
question:
Given only synthetic time-series generated from a known mass-action SBML model
(A -> B, reversible binding A + B <-> C), can the discovery-engine cycle rebuild
a flat SBML that reproduces the trajectories and recovers the actual reactions
and rate constants?
hypothesis:
Mass-action is the floor: linear/bilinear rate laws and a handful of reactions.
The cycle should recover both the trajectory (to tight tolerance) and the exact
reaction set + rate constants with no spurious reactions, calibrating the
trajectory and structural scoring for the whole ladder.
objective:
Generate a ground-truth mass-action SBML, simulate it to synthetic targets, hide
the model, and run the build -> simulate -> compare -> refine loop to recover a
flat SBML. Score trajectory fidelity, structural recovery, and parsimony.
description:
Baseline rung of the recovery ladder. The ground truth is a small mass-action
network (A -> B with rate k1; A + B <-> C with k2/k2r). A synthetic-target
generator simulates it (tellurium) to produce the observed species trajectories;
only those trajectories + the species list are exposed to the loop. The
discovery-engine cycle proposes candidate reactions, simulates, compares to the
target, and refines until acceptance. Because the oracle is known, structural
recovery and parsimony are gradeable exactly. This study calibrates the
trajectory-comparator and structural-scorer capabilities before the harder rungs.

expected_behavior.name: mass-action-trajectory-recovered
expected_behavior.observable: recovered-model simulation vs synthetic target trajectory (per species, shared time grid)
expected_behavior.condition: normalized RMSE < 0.05 across all observed species
expected_behavior.rationale: the recovered model must reproduce the data it was fit to before any structural claim is meaningful.

expected_behavior.name: mass-action-structure-recovered
expected_behavior.observable: recovered reaction set + rate constants vs the ground-truth SBML
expected_behavior.condition: every ground-truth reaction is present and each rate constant is within 10% of truth
expected_behavior.rationale: mass-action is fully identifiable from clean data, so genuine recovery means getting the actual mechanism, not just a fit.

expected_behavior.name: mass-action-parsimonious
expected_behavior.observable: number of reactions / parameters in the recovered model vs ground truth
expected_behavior.condition: recovered reaction count <= ground-truth count (no spurious reactions)
expected_behavior.rationale: a correct recovery introduces no extra machinery; parsimony separates recovery from overfitting.

claim: Recovered faithfully from data: SINDy discovers the 3-reaction network and the fit reproduces the trajectories (nrmse ~1e-9). The cycle rebuilds this flat mass-action SBML from data alone.
